name: Dashboard
author: Kirin
short: Unicornia's staff and member web sites, behind Discord login
description: Serves staff.unicornia.net (ban records, AutoMod, read-only Unicornia and modmail history, for staff with 2FA) and my.unicornia.net (profile, backgrounds and leaderboard for every member, roleplay settings; custom commands, emojis and role for supporters) from inside the bot.
install_msg: Thanks for installing the Dashboard. Follow the README deployment checklist before loading it.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data about users. Staff logins read the Discord account's ID and 2FA status once, and member logins read only the account's ID; the resulting session is held in memory only and ends after 12 hours, on logout, or when the cog unloads. The staff site shows modmail conversations read-only from the modmail bot's database, with attachment links re-signed through Discord when viewed and held in memory until they expire; no copy is kept. Changes made on the member site are stored by the cog that owns them (CustomCommand, CustomEmoji, CustomRoleColor, Roleplay, Unicornia).
